ByteDance is a technology company seeking a graduate Backend Software Engineer to join its DCS platform team. The role focuses on building platforms, systems, services, and productivity tools for large-scale production systems, while designing, developing, testing, deploying, maintaining, and improving software.

Required
Individuals who are completing or have recently completed a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, a similar technical field of study, or equivalent practical experience
Coursework, academic projects, or internship experience in two or more of the following: web application development, Unix/Linux environments, distributed and parallel systems, networking systems, or building software systems
Strong foundational programming and problem-solving skills, with the ability to learn new systems and tools quickly
Successful candidates must be able to commit to an onboarding date by the end of the year. Please state your availability and graduation date clearly in your resume
Preferred
Exposure to GPU computing, big data technologies (Hadoop/Kafka/Apache), or streaming/computing concepts through coursework, internships, or personal projects
Software development experience with Golang or Python, through coursework, internships, or personal projects
Familiarity with the web stack, including protocols and basic web server concepts
Experience troubleshooting technical issues in an academic, internship, or personal project setting
Genuine interest in IT Operations concepts such as Discovery, Insights, and Configuration Management (DICM), IT Operations Management (ITOM), or IT Service Management (ITSM); prior coursework or exposure is a plus but not required
